# EFLOOR

> EFLOOR is an Indonesian supplier and distributor of vinyl carpet glue
> ("lem vinyl"), carpet tile glue ("lem karpet"), and PVC trim
> accessories (list plint/skirting, list siku step nosing, adaptasi
> transisi), serving flooring installers, contractors, and retail
> customers across Indonesia.

Store location: Kelapa Gading, North Jakarta. Sells via the website,
WhatsApp, and official Shopee/Tokopedia shops.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://efloor.id/): product overview and company introduction.
- [Products](https://efloor.id/products): full catalog of glue and trim products.
- [Pricing guide](https://efloor.id/harga-lem-vinyl-karpet): lem vinyl and lem karpet pricing.
- [Lem Lapangan Padel & Rumput Sintetis](https://efloor.id/lem-lapangan-padel): polyurethane glue for artificial-turf seams (padel courts, gardens) and lightweight bricks; 450 g and 33 kg.
- [Lem Karpet & Vinyl ECO](https://efloor.id/lem-karpet-vinyl-eco): budget waterbased carpet/vinyl glue, 1/4/20 kg, 8–10 m² per kg.
- [Catalogs (PDF)](https://efloor.id/katalog): downloadable product sheets with prices, colour codes and sizes, plus TDS/MSDS.
- [Blog](https://efloor.id/blogs): installation guides and product articles.
- [Contact](https://efloor.id/kontak): store address, hours, WhatsApp, phone.
- [About](https://efloor.id/about-us): company background.
- [Projects](https://efloor.id/projects): completed installation projects.
